title: Hire Desk Coordinator
description:
Join a busy customer operations team where no two days are the same

KMC Recruitment is working with a well-established hire business to recruit a Hire Desk Coordinator for its Ipswich operation.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys speaking with customers, coordinating multiple tasks at once and making sure everything runs smoothly from enquiry through to delivery. You'll be part of a supportive team, acting as the first point of contact for customers while working closely with colleagues across the business to deliver a first-class service.

Whether you're already working within the hire industry or have a strong customer service background and are looking for your next challenge, we'd like to hear from you.

The Role

As part of a busy customer service and hire desk team, you'll be responsible for managing customer enquiries, arranging hires and ensuring customers receive a professional, efficient service throughout the process.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Responding to customer enquiries by telephone and email.
- Preparing quotations and processing hire orders accurately.
- Liaising with operational teams to coordinate deliveries, collections and equipment availability.
- Building strong relationships with both new and existing customers.
- Providing advice on products and services to help customers find the right solution.
- Supporting Business Development Managers with customer accounts and enquiries.
- Maintaining accurate records and ensuring all documentation is completed correctly.
- Working collaboratively with colleagues to deliver excellent service and resolve any issues quickly.

About You

We're looking for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and takes pride in delivering outstanding customer service.

You'll ideally have:
- Previous experience in a customer service, hire desk, sales support or coordination role.
- Excellent communication skills, both over the phone and in writing.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise a busy workload.
- Good attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Confidence using Microsoft Office, including Excel.
- A positive attitude and willingness to support the wider team.
- GCSE English (Grade 4/C or above), or equivalent.

Experience within the plant hire, construction, tool hire or related sectors would be advantageous, although it isn't essential.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of £32,640.
- Up to 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays.
- Option to buy additional holiday and carry unused leave forward.
- Extra day's holiday for your birthday.
- Company pension with employer contribution.
- Enhanced family leave.
- Death in Service cover.
- Medicash healthcare plan.
- High street retail discounts.
- Cycle to Work scheme.
- Regular performance and development reviews.
- A friendly, supportive working environment with genuine opportunities to develop your career.

If you're looking for a customer-focused role where you can make a real impact while developing your career within a successful national business, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Maintenance Administrator
description:
Maintenance Administrator

Ipswich, Suffolk
£14.42 an hour

Temporary assignment

Monday to Friday 8am to 5pm

A leading property maintenance and building services organisation, known for delivering high-quality work across the country, is looking for some additional help within its team. The company provides a wide range of commercial services including reactive and planned maintenance, electrical and plumbing support, and general multi-trade works.

We are seeking a confident and detail-driven Administrator to help keep daily operations running efficiently. This role sits at the heart of the maintenance team, ensuring smooth communication and supporting the coordination of ongoing works.

What you will be doing:

As a Maintenance Administrator, you will be responsible for keeping workflows organised, maintaining accurate information, and supporting the wider operational team. You'll act as a key link between engineers, clients, subcontractors, and internal departments.

Your duties will include:
- Overseeing and coordinating admin processes for both planned and reactive maintenance tasks
- Scheduling, allocating, and monitoring jobs through to completion
- Managing operatives' calendars, workloads, and appointments
- Serving as the first point of contact for clients, tenants, or residents
- Maintaining accurate systems, data, and documentation
- Providing administrative support to supervisors and managers, including reporting
- Communicating effectively with clients, internal teams, and external partners
- Identifying issues early and helping resolve them to keep service delivery on track

What We're Looking For

You'll be someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment and is able to juggle multiple tasks with confidence. Strong communication skills, great organisation, and a proactive approach are all essential.

To be successful, you must have:
- Previous administration experience within construction, maintenance, or a related sector
- Strong IT skills, particularly in Microsoft Word, Excel, and email systems
- Excellent communication and customer service abilities
- Strong organisation and time-management skills
- A positive, solution-focused mindset
- The ability to work independently while also being a supportive team player
- Flexibility to share the on-call responsibilities amongst the team

description:
Project Coordinator

Bury St Edmunds - 1 day per week / month

£30,000 per annum

This is an opportunity to join a growing software business providing technology to the commercial property sector, with its platform used by customers across more than 30 countries. You'll join their Delivery team, helping to coordinate customer software implementations and ensure projects remain organised and on track.

You'll support projects from initial setup through to go-live, coordinating meetings, maintaining project plans and documentation, tracking actions and milestones and keeping customers and internal teams updated. Working closely with colleagues across Product, Engineering and Account Management, you'll help make sure everyone knows what needs to happen, when it needs to happen and that actions don't get missed.

We're open to existing Project Coordinators or Project Administrators, as well as people from administration, operations, customer service or customer success backgrounds looking to move into Project Management. Previous software or project experience would be beneficial but isn't essential.

Above all, we're looking for someone who is highly organised, confident communicating with different people, comfortable managing multiple priorities and keen to build a career within projects and technology.
